eventDetail.scope: The International Conference on NexGen Networks and Cybernetics (IC2NC) aims to bring together leading researchers, academicians, industry experts, and practitioners to discuss and explore advancements in next-generation networks and cybernetics. The conference provides a platform for exchanging ideas, sharing research findings, and fostering collaborations in the domains of networking technologies, cybersecurity, artificial intelligence, and cyber-physical systems.
